public_definitions: Goal: Review the regional spend and sales dashboard, then choose the spend-increase decision.
Comparison scope: Use the regional spend and sales dashboard to complete the spend increase form.

Rules: Choose one of the three options: Hold recommendation and request full regional spend-sales analysis, Approve broader region-wide spend increase, Approve a limited pilot increase for selected regions only.
